Reading: CONSISTENT

The reviewer's reasoning argues that the alleged omission is not actually an omission because the substance of the claim (the internal inconsistency about medium-dose ICS+LABA) is already addressed in Findings 1 and 2, even if characterized somewhat differently. The reasoning concludes that "no ruling on the omitted claim is warranted" because the point is already covered. This reasoning directly supports the ruling line `NOT AN OMISSION`. The reviewer has settled the contest by establishing that what was claimed to be omitted was in fact already present in substance within the existing findings.
